title: ITU Receives New IPv6 and Internet Governance Proposals Ahead of November Conference
description: New proposals submitted to the ITU address IPv6 deployment, internationalized domain names and Internet governance, with competing regional amendments awaiting consideration at the November Plenipotentiary Conference in Doha.

title: 4 real? Tracking exploitation and patching of eMudhra’s weak keys
description: Four, just four: that’s the key to break into any unpatched connection on the Internet that is using eMudhra certificates. Here’s how we quickly patched Cloudflare, what evidence we can see of attempted exploitation, and how much of the rest of the Internet remains exposed.

title: Bangla Is on ICANN’s Script List. Where Are the Applicants?
description: ICANN's 2026 new gTLD round attracted no Bangla-script applications, despite supporting 27 scripts. Application data reveals limited South Asian participation and a sharp decline in internationalized domain applications compared with 2012.

title: Cloudflare services for private origins is now generally available
description: Public traffic to private origins, with WAF, bot management, caching, and Workers, is now available to every customer with Cloudflare One connectivity.

title: Suggested IETF 127 Sessions for Getting Familiar with New Topics
description: These IETF 127 meeting sessions are likely to include discussions and proposals that are accessible to a broad range of Internet technologists whether they are new to the IETF or long-time participants.

title: Same place, different view: How VPNs shape what we learn about the Internet
description: Guest Post: A study found that changing VPN providers can change where web traffic appears to be served, affecting conclusions about domestic infrastructure, cross-border traffic, and data localization.

title: Pentagon Investigates Military Base Freezer Failures as Suspected Cyberattack
description: The Pentagon is investigating unexplained refrigeration failures at six US military commissaries as a possible cyberattack, while French authorities examine attacks on Internet-connected refrigeration systems affecting hundreds of supermarkets.

title: DNSSEC in Ghana: 99% Can Validate, But .gh Remains Unsigned
description: Ghana reports approximately 99% DNSSEC validation capability among measured users, yet its .gh domain remains unsigned, exposing a gap between resolver readiness and domain security that calls for coordinated deployment and operational planning.

title: Global Internet Infrastructure at NANOG 98: Growth, Ownership, and Sovereignty
description: Growing demand for international bandwidth is accelerating investment in submarine cables and satellite networks, while increasing ownership concentration among major technology companies raises questions about competition, infrastructure resilience and national sovereignty.

title: Cloudflare DDoS Threat Report 2026 Q3: More swarms, fewer giants
description: Cloudflare mitigated over 8,200 DDoS attacks per hour in Q3 2026 as attackers shifted to shorter, high-frequency strikes. Explore the latest threat data, including the collapse of CLDAP vectors and the impact of recent botnet takedowns.

title: APNIC updates conference host and location selection process
description: APNIC has updated its conference host and location selection process for stand-alone conferences to give prospective hosts clearer guidance and make assessment and decision-making more transparent.

title: [Podcast] Quad9 — Measurement in the privacy-preserving public DNS service
description: Darren Kara discusses how the Quad9 Public DNS server balances privacy, measurement, and global threat intelligence to help protect users from malicious destinations.

title: Who Still Governs Africa’s Internet Resources?
description: Cloud Innovation's reappearance in AFRINIC's Mauritian membership register raises questions about governance, judicial oversight and institutional independence. The author calls for transparent records, scrutiny of conflicts of interest and an orderly end to receivership.

title: Iran Escalates Threats Against Gulf Undersea Internet Cables
description: Iranian officials have outlined plans to target undersea Internet cables in the Strait of Hormuz, while a new propaganda video depicts attacks that could disrupt connectivity across Gulf states.

title: Quad9’s Planned Departure From France Shows Why Internet Infrastructure Policy Needs a Wider Lens
description: Quad9's planned withdrawal from France over DNS blocking orders highlights the tension between copyright enforcement and Internet security, raising questions about whether infrastructure-level restrictions impose consequences beyond their intended targets.

title: Google and Meta Undersea Cables Rank Among Pacific’s Most Vulnerable to Sabotage
description: New research ranks trans-Pacific submarine cables by sabotage vulnerability, identifying Google and Meta projects among high-risk systems while documenting Chinese research vessel activity near critical underwater communications infrastructure.

title: Global Internet infrastructure at NANOG 98
description: Hyperscaler investment in submarine cables and the rise of LEO satellite systems are reshaping who builds, owns, and operates the networks that underpin global connectivity.

title: The EVPN trust challenge: How to detect and contain internal MAC hijacks
description: Guest Post: EVPN MAC mobility enables seamless workload movement, but it can also amplify the impact of MAC spoofing. A forged MAC address can redirect traffic across the fabric through BGP, making access-layer controls, route-reflector visibility, and MAC-move monitoring critica…

title: CISA Unveils 2030 Strategy to Shift U.S. Cyber Defense Toward Proactive Threat Removal
description: CISA's new 2030 strategy shifts US cyber defense toward proactive threat removal, prioritizing critical infrastructure protection and national resilience, with implementation milestones set for the coming year.

title: Introducing the Cloudflare PHP Capture the Flag challenge
description: We are launching a PHP Capture the Flag challenge integrated with our Bug Bounty program to test our WAF protections. Security researchers are invited to bypass our defenses and capture the flag to help make the Internet safer.

title: What took the Internet offline in Q3 2026
description: An examination of global Internet disruptions observed by Cloudflare Radar during the third quarter of 2026. This review analyzes how power failures, natural disasters, and government shutdowns impacted network connectivity and traffic.

title: APRICOT 2027 Call for Presentations is open now
description: If you have interesting Internet operations research or experience to share, submit a presentation for APRICOT 2027. Submissions close on 25 January 2027.

title: APNIC 62 workshops help build network security, automation, and routing expertise across the region

title: Cross-request KV cache exposure in the GLM-5.3 Workers AI model, and our remediation with SGLang
description: A configuration mismatch in GLM 5.3 on Workers AI triggered an SGLang bug that exposed KV cache pages across requests. Here is how we addressed the issue.

title: One week on the APNIC honeynet: 99,000 IP addresses and 173 million events
description: Nearly 99,000 unique IP addresses interacted with APNIC's honeynet in just one week, generating 173 million events across SSH, Telnet, SMB, VPN, web, and Android services. The results show that long-known botnets, weak credentials, and unpatched vulnerabilities continue to drive …

title: Origin Range Requests: Serving large files without range-request tuning
description: Naive byte-range caching can waste gigabytes of origin bandwidth on small requests. We rebuilt our cache architecture in Pingora to coordinate partial fetches automatically, cutting R2 p99 latency in half.

title: Bringing post-quantum cryptography to geographically fenced key management
description: Cloudflare's new post-quantum GeoKey Manager protects geographically fenced decryption keys from harvest now, decrypt later attacks. Learn how we redesigned our cryptography stack to support strict data sovereignty in a post-quantum world.

title: Introducing full transaction detection for Cloudflare WAF
description: Cloudflare's web application firewall can now correlate an HTTP request with its response. Full transaction detection helps every customer find successful exploits, data exposure, and risky misconfigurations that request-only inspection can miss.
